note: Magitek Wars generation list. The shipped sound is ElevenLabs, made by tools/audio/eleven.mjs (PLAN D38); the local Audio Studio (port 7890, tools/audio/gen.mjs) reads the same prompts. An effect with layers is mixed from separately generated parts (eleven.mjs only). ids are the delivery file names under public/audio/. sfx ids match LogEntry.k so src/audio/audio.ts plays them by name; a kind without a sample plays its synthesized voice. Steam, brass, iron and gloam: no crystal, no published game's sounds. Loops are made seamless by level.mjs.
